text:
Predicates:
Allowed(x, y) ::: x is allowed to have pet y in a managed building.
DepositRequired(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in managed building x.
SecurityDeposit(x, y) ::: The security deposit for building x is y dollars.
Fluffy ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(x, y) ::: The monthly rent at building x is y dollars.
RentTom(x) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in building x.
MoveInWithTom(x) ::: Tom is allowed to move in with pet x.
MoreThan(x, y) ::: x is more than y.
NoMoreThan(x, y) ::: x is no more than y.
Premises:
∃x (ManagedBuilding(x) ∧ Allowed(x, y) ∧ Pet(y)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) → DepositRequired(x)) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
∀x ∀y (SecurityDeposit(x, y) → (y = OneMonthRent(x) ∨ y > OneMonthRent(x))) ::: The security deposit can be either equal to one month's rent or more.
Cat(fluffy) ∧ Fluffy = Tom's cat ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat.
∀x (Cat(x) → Pet(x)) ::: Cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
RentTom(x) ↔ (Allowed(x, fluffy) ∧ NoMoreThan(SecurityDeposit(x), 1500)) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
MoreThan(2000, 1500) ::: 2000$ is more than $1500.
Conclusion:
RentTom(oliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
